page.layout: One column of running text, top to bottom. Below it, a woodcut ornament (not text). At the lower right, the catchword IUSTI. Running head centred at top, page number at top left. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: gine esse me sentio, & velut nube? quàm quæ volo, non volo; quæ possum, non possum? Sed prorsus, ut ij qui vincti & impediti sunt, membra habent ad visum, nec utuntur: sic mens, lingua, stilus, adstricta ad morbi hanc catenam[?]. Solve me eâ Deus, cùm tibi visum: aut his totis vinculis solve, si visum; ut li-ber & solutus te, apud te, fruar, in æterna illa luce de-spector aut irrisor eorum quæ nunc miramur. Interea dum hoc fit, in statione maneo, & nec saucius eam desero: ut si manu & operâ haud multùm, animo ta-men iuvem & exemplo. Interpretare sic Lector, & hæc accipe, quædam etiam eius generis opportunè in FACE nostrâ habiturus.

page.notes: Woodcut ornament (a cartouche with a figure, foliage and scrollwork) lies below the text; it is an illustration, not transcribed. Faint show-through text from the reverse page appears in the lower half and is left out. The word "catenam" ends with a curled mark that may be an abbreviation sign; read as printed with [?]. Catchword IUSTI is capitalised as printed (V for U rendered as U).
